t1.text: Docker update notice: web UI and desktop

q1.text:
How the server would know (proposal):

The Docker server has no update check today, so its version shows alone. It would read a small signed file, manifest-docker.json, that the Docker workflow attaches to each release it builds. A Windows-only release (like 0.7.3) carries the previous one, as with the Linux file, so Docker users are only told about images that exist.

Once a day, plus at start. INBOUND_UPDATE_CHECK=false turns it off. It never updates by itself.

q2.text:
Open questions:

1. Not now hides it until the next start of the page (or a day). Skip this version hides it until a newer one. Kept on the server per user, so the web UI and the desktop window agree. OK?

2. Show it to every signed-in user, or only to the server's admin?

3. Notice in the desktop window too (4), or only the version note in the status bar?
